text:
maria: quick heads-up — ran a heads x RoPE scaling sweep on mixtral-7b with longctx (8k). hit a pretty sharp perf cliff when head_dim >= 192 at batch sizes >8, KV cache eviction rates spike and kernel selector falls back to generic path. summary below.

sam: can you paste the raw profiler snippet and which kernel was selected? :eyes:

maria: hereʼs the short repro output i used:```
Model: mixtral-7b
ctx: 8192
batch: 16
heads: 32
head_dim: 192
kernel: fallback_generic_attention
kv_cache_evictions: 34%
p50: 210ms (baseline 160ms)
p95: 820ms
notes: selector chose generic because per-head kv size exceeded fast_attention tile limit
```
iyon: that looks like shared-memory pressure — head_dim*heads grows k/v slice size so the optimized kernel no longer fits its tile assumptions. eviction% makes sense.
alex: potential mitigations: force kernel hint for this model (prefer_fast_attention) or add a dynamic batch cap (cap batches when seq_len*head_dim*heads > threshold). also prefix KV caching cut down repeated recompute in my quick run.
maria: tried a quick cap to batch=8: p50 -> 175ms but overall throughput (tokens/s) drops for high-concurrency jobs. batch=16 gives higher throughput but much worse tail latency.
tara: did you try INT8/quant variants? any difference?
maria: int8 improved absolute numbers slightly (p50 ~170ms at batch=8) but cliff still present — selector still falling back. looks like the kernel decision is primarily driven by tile-fit, not compute precision.
sam: proposed action items: 1) add explicit kernel_hint for mixtral-7b in model-catalog to force fast attention for our preferred hw profiles 2) implement dynamic batch cap heuristic (based on heads*head_dim*seq_len) in batching layer 3) add a perf regression alert tied to this sweep so we catch rollbacks.
perf-bot: created PERF-2026-1132 for mixtral-7b kernel fallback spike and linked the repro.
maria: iʼll open a PR with the catalog hint + a unittest that runs the repro (small ctx) and asserts selector picks the fast kernel on our CI hw. pushing repro script to s3:/perf/repro/mixtral-headdim-ropesweep.sh
iyon: i can prototype a selector threshold tweak — will test if increasing tile_limit by 10% avoids the fallback without regressing other models.
alex: if you want longer sweeps i have the midnight slot on the perf rig, can run a dense grid (head_dim 128/160/192/224 x batch 4/8/12/16) and collect NVTX traces.
maria: great — pls run that and drop traces here. also adding a note for ops: if we see similar spikes in production, temporary mitigation is to set per-model batch_cap=8 for mixtral-7b.
sam: awesome. thanks everyone — this explains a few of the noisy latency regressions we saw in the last rollout. follow-ups: samantha will review PR, iyon will prototype selector tweak, alex will run sweep.
alex: will do. :thumbsup:
maria: closing loop later today with numbers and PR link.
